common.analysis: Paired differences with group-level resampling; report negative and missing results, actual bytes, and actual computation. No SOTA-superiority statement before matched outcomes.

distgp.question: Accuracy, uncertainty, and supported route decisions under the same measurement evidence.
native_admission: Exact official source commit and software license
Unmodified official small regression/mapping example with declared finite-output and upstream-check agreement criteria
Environment, input hashes, logs, and upstream outputs captured

candidate_data.support: Identical existing 0.65-distance measurement support; common supported queries only, with missing estimates explicit.

matched_stages: Representation comparison on identical four-reading sender batches; this does not test distributed fusion.
Distributed extension only after a native example: identical local measurement streams and fixed communication opportunities, with actual messages/bytes counted.
distgp.common_downstream: Use identical candidate paths, midpoint quadrature, clipping convention, receiver pricing and tie-breaking. DistGP inference may replace the field estimator only; retain all evaluation-world truth exclusion.
unresolved_until_native: Exact distributed-message mapping, finite work ceilings, and calibration-only tuning split
distgp.gate: No comparisons while official source or native reproduction is missing. A fitted dense GP or independently reconstructed equations must not be labeled reproduced DistGP.

ugv_exposure.question: Task-conditioned exposure belief and routing under matched sensing and execution.
native_admission: Exact official source commit and software license
Run the official small published one-UGV/UAV setting without CoPH substitution
Capture original terrain prior, hazard-detection, sensing confidence, aerial mobility, planner budget, and expected checks

candidate_data.reference: Existing hazard_demo specifications; crossing_demo for reciprocal descriptive comparison only

matched_stages: Unadapted published role/configuration reproduction is a separate result.

Controlled-scout adapter: identical pre-recorded legal scout observations, shared downstream physical executor and common receiver objective; tests exposure belief/route scoring, not full UAV acquisition.
Full active-sensing comparison requires identical aerial mobility, sensing actions, acquisition budgets and public priors for both systems; freeze that protocol only after native reproduction.
ugv_exposure.reciprocal_boundary: Original one-UGV/shared-belief role configuration is not automatically a reciprocal independent-agent baseline. Any reciprocal extension is a separately named adaptation, with neither its success nor failure attributed to the original publication.
ugv_exposure.gate: No CoPH-versus-exposure-planner performance table until native reproduction and adapter validation pass. Do not compare the printed 38-percent paper result with CoPH hazard costs.
